name: gradient
title: Gradient
description: A gradient being made: its stops on a bar, the stop in hand in a color picker, and its type, angle and centre.
use: A reader makes a linear, radial or conic gradient for a background, a theme or a brand asset. The value is the gradient as data: its type, angle, centre and stops, each stop with an id, an offset and a color; gradientCss() writes it as CSS for the preview and the copy alike. Every control in it is the library's own: color-picker, slider, number input, segmented and dial.

instead.when: A color is chosen from a few the page offers

keyboard.action: Moves to the stop in hand on the bar, then through the controls; the other stops are reached by taking them in hand with the pointer or from their place in the tab order of the bar
On a stop: moves it one point toward the end; ten with Shift. ArrowRight goes left where the page runs right to left
On a stop: moves it one point toward the start; ten with Shift
On a stop: moves it ten points
On a stop: moves it to 0 or to 100
On a stop: removes it while there are more than two, and hands focus to its neighbor

platform.feature: Gradients interpolated in a color space, as in linear-gradient(in oklab …)
platform.fallback: The preview and the bar are painted from --gradient-fallback, interpolated in sRGB
The controls stay in one column at every width

classes.name: gradient
classes.description: The editor: a preview, a bar of stops and the controls. The gradient behavior writes the stops' handles and publishes the gradient. Mark aria-readonly="true" or aria-disabled="true" on it to keep it from changing

classes.name: gradient-preview
classes.description: The gradient over a checkerboard, 16 : 9 unless --gradient-ratio says otherwise; hide it with aria-hidden, since the stops and the CSS say the same

classes.name: gradient-bar
classes.description: The stops from start to end, whatever the type, as a short well the handles stand on

classes.name: gradient-stop
classes.description: A stop's handle, written by the behavior: a disc of its color in a pearl ring at --gradient-offset along the bar, a slider of the offset named with its place among the stops

classes.name: gradient-fields
classes.description: The controls, in one column, and two side by side when the room allows

classes.name: gradient-color
classes.description: Holds the color-picker of the stop in hand; the gradient behavior attaches the picker

classes.name: gradient-offset
classes.description: Holds a range and a number input, from 0 to 100, for the offset of the stop in hand

classes.name: gradient-type
classes.description: Holds the radios, linear, radial and conic, that choose the type; a segmented control

classes.name: gradient-angle
classes.description: Holds a dial of the angle, from 0 to 360 degrees, for a linear and a conic gradient

classes.name: gradient-center
classes.description: Holds two number inputs, the centre's x and y in percent, for a radial and a conic gradient

classes.name: gradient-add
classes.description: Adds a stop of the color in hand ten points after it, 100 at most

classes.name: gradient-remove
classes.description: Removes the stop in hand; disabled at two stops

classes.name: gradient-css
classes.description: The gradient as CSS to copy, written by the behavior: the fallback, then the line interpolated in OKLab

states.name: in hand
states.description: The stop the controls show: it stands a little forward with an ink ring

states.name: locked
states.description: The gradient is read-only or disabled: the handle does not move

states.name: disabled
states.description: The editor is not in use: it fades

properties.name: --gradient
properties.description: The gradient interpolated in OKLab, written by the behavior

properties.name: --gradient-fallback
properties.description: The gradient interpolated in sRGB, for a browser that cannot be told how to interpolate

properties.name: --gradient-offset
properties.description: Where a handle stands along the bar, from 0 to 100, written by the behavior

properties.name: --gradient-color
properties.description: The color of a handle's stop, written by the behavior
